title: Lovely Artwork
text: Lovely Artwork. I am kind of bummed with this product. The enamelwork and art is very attractive and fun. The cup is a really nice size. The issues are in quality control. Imagine that? One tumbler seems thicker and better made than the other. Neither of the, are suitable for drinking out of due to the rims being rough in places from an over run of the enamel process.  I'll be using these for non drinking purposes only.

product_metadata.title: Hand Painted Steel Tumbler Mug- Zahra Pack of two, 13 Oz Elephant Design Pink Tumblers (Without Lid), Ideal Water/Tea/Coffee Glasses | Camping Cups |
